peak-body: Golden Week, 1–7 October, hits Noi Bai's biggest market — 33 flights a day from mainland China. Our priority lane bypasses the queue — through in about 15 minutes.
faq-night: Thirteen international flights land at Noi Bai inside that window on a typical October day, most of them from mainland China and Korea. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.
faq-delay: No problem at all. We monitor your flight in real time and adjust accordingly. Our staff will be there whether your flight lands early, on time, or late — just as one of our guests experienced when their flight arrived 1.5 hours ahead of schedule. One thing to check this month: the winter flight schedule starts on 25 October and many arrival times move with it, so confirm your time with the airline if you booked earlier.
faq-connection: Fast Track Arrival ends once you are through immigration at Terminal 2; it does not cover the domestic terminal. If your international flight lands at T2 and your domestic flight leaves from Terminal 1, the connection is a separate journey: immigration, a terminal change and a second check-in. The tightest window is midday — 27 international flights land at Noi Bai between 12:00 and 15:00, so a connection booked in those hours leaves the least margin.
